settings.headline: Accessibility
settings.subtitle: Plain HTML first: every page on this demo works without JavaScript, uses real headings and tables, and keeps alert text as text — never only a color or a map pin.

settings.headline: What we aim for
settings.body: WCAG 2.2 AA as the working target (story statement): keyboard-visible focus, contrast-checked status colors with text labels, and quality tables that read in order on a screen reader.
settings.side: In a real district this page would name an accessibility coordinator. Here it names the standard the templates were built to.
